name: Cecilia Farias Temirana
original_name: セシリア・ファリアス・テミラーナ
source:
"...Even so, I want to create my ideal order of knights. I want to carve out the future together with them."

She is the third princess of the country of Temilana. She has "strong luck" that allows her to visually see the path she should take when she is in danger.

As a member of the royal family, she behaves gracefully in public, but when she talks to her close friends, she uses informal language and shows her normal girlish side.

Because she is hated by the royal family as a "cursed princess", she lives in a short distance away from the royal castle.

[Translated from [url=https://www.otomate.jp/tsuitsui/chara/]official website[/url]]
